comment: The known breaches of the raw-controls guard (raw-controls.test.ts). A RATCHET: the list only shrinks. Each entry: file, tag (button, input, select or textarea) and count. Remove an entry (or lower its count) when the breach is gone; the guard fails if a listed breach is gone but still listed, and for any breach not listed. Never add an entry or raise a count: use the shared UI component instead.
